label: live
test: step corrections survive reload and undo launches the requested redo with visible history
expected: the Jevellan web app "undo retry" screen, one step of the check "step corrections survive reload and undo launches the requested redo with visible history", at desktop-dark, rendered completely and legibly

cosmetic: The same error message ('No model can run this step right now: disabled, disabled, …') appears 3 times: a red banner, an amber banner and the Resume correction card.
The error lists 'disabled' eight times without naming any models, so it doesn't say which models are unavailable.
The timeline is scrolled, so the top of the earlier step is clipped under the header (only its dashed border shows). Only part of the correction history is visible without scrolling up.
The completed handoff line ('Changed the value and kept the requested scope.') and its HANDOFF/DONE labels are struck through and dim, so they're harder to read.
The composer chips say 'Next step: Auto / Model: Auto / Effort: Auto', but the 'Pick the next step' panel above shows Reply / Fable / high, so the two disagree.

The conversation titles in the sidebar and the Resume correction card both say 'step 1'. The sidebar titles are cut off with ellipses, and two items have nearly the same title ('Change the value to three, the…'), so they're hard to tell apart.
The secondary text ('Completed undo changes are kept…', the 'What would you like to do next?' placeholder) is low-contrast against the dark background.
